title: DJIA Market Happenings For Monday, April 30, 2018
text:
DJIA Market Happenings For Monday, April 30, 2018 Posted by admin on April 30th, Intel (INTC) and Microsoft (MSFT). up +127 points.
Friday the Dow was down -11.15 (-0.05%) at 24,311.19.
Year-to-date the Dow is down -1.65%.
There were 14 Dow stocks up Friday.
The Dow stock winners Friday were led by Verizon (VZ) +3.64% and Nike (NKE) +2.22%.
The Dow stock losers Friday were led by Exxon Mobil (XOM) -3.80% and Apple (AAPL) -1.16%.
Shares in burger chain McDonald’s (MCD) are up 3.5% after reporting better-than-expected profit and revenue for the first quarter.
European stocks are mostly higher up three-tenths of a cent reports open.
Pfizer (PFE) reports open.
American Express (AXP)
American Express (AXP) is up +0.30% year-to-date.
